title: Owens tries to sway football games while drinking
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Owens tries to sway football games while drinking, about 1970s-1980s at Owens' living room, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He would uh occasionally sit in his living room smoking cigars and drinking whiskey and he'd have two or three TV sets going with football games and he would try and influence the outcome of the football games from a a state of intoxication.

plain: Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychic claims, told podcast host Jesse Michels about the habits of Ted Owens, a man who said he had psychic powers. According to Mishlove, Owens would sit in his living room smoking cigars and drinking whiskey with two or three TV sets showing football games, trying to change how the games turned out while drunk. If true, it would mean the mind can push on events far away.
